view.home.welcome:
Tasks from the git repositories in this workspace.
[Open Speclog](command:speclog.open)
command.installHook: Install commit-msg hook in this repository
config.roots: Folders whose direct child folders are scanned for git repositories, in addition to the workspace folders. Use absolute paths; `~` stands for your home folder. Relative paths are ignored.
config.exclude: Folder names that are never scanned.
config.originFilter: Only repositories whose `origin` URL contains one of these fragments (for example `github.com/owner/`). Empty: all repositories.
config.fetch.enabled: Fetch `origin` in the background. Only `refs/remotes/origin/*` is updated; the working tree is never touched.
config.fetch.intervalSeconds: Seconds between two background fetches of a repository.
config.branchDays: Only unmerged branches with a commit in the last this-many days are read. Older branches are invisible to Speclog: they add no items, show no On branch and no stale-branch row. 0 reads every branch (slow in repositories with thousands of branches).
config.staleBranchDays: A branch with unmerged task work whose tip is older than this many days is listed under Attention.
config.unverifiedDone: How a `done` written by hand in Backlog.md or Spec Kit task files, without a `Task:` commit, is shown.
config.unverifiedDone.done: Shown as done, flagged and listed under Attention.
config.agent.target: Where **Send to agent** delivers an item's prompt.
config.agent.target.auto: VS Code chat (the prompt is also copied to the clipboard) when this editor has it and the repository is open in this window, else the clipboard.
config.agent.target.chat: VS Code chat, pre-filled and not sent, and the prompt is also copied to the clipboard; only the clipboard when this editor has no chat or the repository is not open in this window.
config.agent.target.terminal: A new terminal in the repository runs the agent command (speclog.agent.terminalCommand) with the prompt as its last argument.
config.agent.target.clipboard: The prompt is copied; paste it into any agent.
config.agent.terminalCommand: The agent command of the `terminal` target: the executable first, then fixed arguments (for example `["claude", "--model", "opus"]`). The executable is a name found on PATH or an absolute path; a relative path is refused. The prompt is appended as one argument, with no shell in between. A `.cmd` / `.bat` launcher on Windows, or any prompt over 4,000 characters, gets the prompt through a file: the argument is `Read the task in <file> and follow it.` and the prompt is written to a file in Speclog's own storage (deleted after 7 days).
config.agent.promptTemplate: A custom prompt; empty uses the built-in one. Placeholders: `{repo}`, `{repoPath}`, `{id}`, `{title}`, `{status}`, `{size}`, `{priority}`, `{area}`, `{file}`, `{line}`, `{branch}`, `{workBranch}`, `{note}`, `{evidence}`, `{depends}`, `{spec}`, `{closingRules}`, `{guards}`. Guard lines are not added to a custom template unless it has `{guards}`.
